title: Pager spacing pick
intro: The pager touches the filters and the table on Contacts. Every option is opt-in, so screens that place it in a header row, such as AML Cases, do not move. Sample data only.

steps.title: Contacts on a phone (360x640)
steps.question: On a phone, how should the pager sit between the filters and the contacts?

options.name: Space above and below
options.why: The pager stays its own row, with 12px clear on each side.

options.name: Toolbar on the table
options.why: The pager becomes the top row of the table's frame, 12px clear of the filters.

options.name: Footer on the table
options.why: The pager becomes the bottom row of the frame, so on a phone it sits below every card. Tap Whole screen to see it.

options.name: One panel
options.why: Filters, pager and table share one frame, split by hairlines.

steps.title: Contacts on a computer (1280x800)
steps.question: On a computer, how should the pager sit between the filters and the contacts table?

options.name: Space above and below
options.why: The pager stays its own row, with 12px clear on each side.

options.name: Toolbar on the table
options.why: The pager becomes the top row of the table's frame, 12px clear of the filters.

options.name: Footer on the table
options.why: The pager becomes the bottom row of the frame. On a full page of 25 you scroll past every row to reach it.

options.name: One panel
options.why: Filters, pager and table share one frame, split by hairlines.
